en: Define deferred taxes and differentiate between temporary differences and permanent differences
Identify and describe the types of temporary differences that cause deferred tax liabilities or deferred tax assets
Identify the recognition of deferred tax liabilities and assets, and measure the amounts for periodic income taxes
Explain and apply the differences in recognition for deferred tax liabilities and deferred tax assets
Discuss the disclosure requirements of accounting for deferred taxes
Analyze, critically evaluate and interpret issues in accounting for deferred taxes
ms: Takrif cukai tertunda dan bezakan perbezaan sementara dengan perbezaan kekal
Kenal pasti dan huraikan jenis perbezaan sementara yang menyebabkan liabiliti atau aset cukai tertunda
Kenal pasti pengiktirafan liabiliti dan aset cukai tertunda, dan ukur amaun untuk cukai pendapatan berkala
Terangkan dan aplikasikan perbezaan pengiktirafan liabiliti dan aset cukai tertunda
Bincangkan keperluan pendedahan perakaunan cukai tertunda
Analisis, nilai secara kritikal dan tafsir isu perakaunan cukai tertunda

title.en: Introduction: Tax Expense vs Tax Payable
title.ms: Pengenalan: Belanja Cukai vs Cukai Kena Bayar

en: **Accounting:** tax expense is estimated from **profit before tax**, following MFRS.
**Tax law:** tax payable is computed from **taxable income**, following tax rules.
The **two calculations differ**. The differences create a **liability or an asset: deferred tax**.
ms: **Perakaunan:** belanja cukai dianggar daripada **untung sebelum cukai**, mengikut MFRS.
**Undang-undang cukai:** cukai kena bayar dikira daripada **pendapatan boleh cukai**, mengikut peraturan cukai.
**Dua pengiraan berbeza**. Perbezaan itu mewujudkan **liabiliti atau aset: cukai tertunda**.

blocks.en: Total tax expense (P/L) = Current tax + Deferred tax
blocks.ms: Jumlah belanja cukai (P/L) = Cukai semasa + Cukai tertunda

blocks.en: Memory hook: Current tax = what you pay now. Deferred tax = what you will pay (DTL) or get back (DTA) later because of timing.
blocks.ms: Cara ingat: Cukai semasa = apa yang dibayar sekarang. Cukai tertunda = apa yang akan dibayar (DTL) atau dituntut balik (DTA) kemudian kerana masa.

blocks.en: Permanent differences
blocks.ms: Perbezaan kekal

en: Items **not allowable or not taxable** for tax purposes: included in accounting income but **never** in taxable income (or the reverse).
They **never reverse**, so they have **no deferred tax consequences**.
ms: Item **tidak dibenarkan atau tidak dicukai**: masuk pendapatan perakaunan tetapi **tidak pernah** masuk pendapatan boleh cukai (atau sebaliknya).
Ia **tidak pernah berbalik**, jadi **tiada kesan cukai tertunda**.

en: Non-taxable items
Non-deductible items
ms: Item tidak dicukai
Item tidak boleh ditolak

en: Tax-exempt interest
Expenses due to violations of laws (fines and penalties)
ms: Faedah dikecualikan cukai
Belanja akibat pelanggaran undang-undang (denda dan penalti)

en: Life insurance proceeds on the death of an insured executive
Donations to unapproved charities
ms: Hasil insurans hayat atas kematian eksekutif diinsuranskan
Derma kepada badan kebajikan tidak diluluskan

en: Tax-exempt dividend
Meals and entertainment expense
ms: Dividen dikecualikan cukai
Belanja makanan dan hiburan

blocks.en: Temporary differences
blocks.ms: Perbezaan sementara

en: Items treated **differently** for tax and accounting that **reverse** over time.
Arise from **timing differences** and from circumstances **not related to timing**.
They **have deferred tax consequences**, depending on whether they are **taxable** or **deductible**.
ms: Item yang dilayan **berbeza** untuk cukai dan perakaunan dan **berbalik** dari masa ke masa.
Timbul daripada **perbezaan masa** dan keadaan **tidak berkaitan masa**.
Ia **ada kesan cukai tertunda**, bergantung sama ada **boleh dicukai** atau **boleh ditolak**.

blocks.en: Test: "Will this difference reverse?" Yes → temporary → deferred tax. No → permanent → no deferred tax (it only changes the effective tax rate).
blocks.ms: Ujian: "Adakah perbezaan ini akan berbalik?" Ya → sementara → cukai tertunda. Tidak → kekal → tiada cukai tertunda (hanya mengubah kadar cukai efektif).

title.ms: Perbezaan Sementara Boleh Dicukai vs Boleh Ditolak

blocks.en: Extra: the **tax base** of an asset = the amount deductible for tax against future taxable economic benefits when the carrying amount is recovered. The **tax base of a liability** = carrying amount − amounts deductible in future (+ future taxable amounts). Temporary difference = carrying amount − tax base.
blocks.ms: Tambahan: **asas cukai** aset = amaun yang boleh ditolak untuk cukai terhadap manfaat ekonomi boleh dicukai masa depan bila amaun dibawa dipulihkan. **Asas cukai liabiliti** = amaun dibawa − amaun boleh ditolak masa depan (+ amaun boleh dicukai masa depan). Perbezaan sementara = amaun dibawa − asas cukai.

en: Taxable temporary difference
Deductible temporary difference
ms: Perbezaan sementara boleh dicukai
Perbezaan sementara boleh ditolak

en: Effect
Accounting income > taxable income (when it arises); future **taxable** amount
Accounting income < taxable income (when it arises); future **deductible** amount
ms: Kesan
Pendapatan perakaunan > pendapatan boleh cukai (semasa timbul); amaun **boleh dicukai** masa depan
Pendapatan perakaunan < pendapatan boleh cukai (semasa timbul); amaun **boleh ditolak** masa depan

en: Asset
Carrying amount **>** tax base
Carrying amount **<** tax base
ms: Aset
Amaun dibawa **>** asas cukai
Amaun dibawa **<** asas cukai

en: Liability
Carrying amount **<** tax base
Carrying amount **>** tax base
ms: Liabiliti
Amaun dibawa **<** asas cukai
Amaun dibawa **>** asas cukai

en: Result
**Deferred tax LIABILITY** (tax payable in future)
**Deferred tax ASSET** (tax recoverable in future)
ms: Hasil
**LIABILITI cukai tertunda** (cukai kena bayar masa depan)
**ASET cukai tertunda** (cukai boleh dituntut masa depan)

blocks.en: Memory hook: Asset carrying amount ABOVE tax base → DTL. Liability carrying amount ABOVE tax base → DTA. (Asset and liability are opposites.)
blocks.ms: Cara ingat: Amaun dibawa aset DI ATAS asas cukai → DTL. Amaun dibawa liabiliti DI ATAS asas cukai → DTA. (Aset dan liabiliti bertentangan.)

blocks.en: The slide says a deductible temporary difference "creates deferred tax assets for the taxes to be paid on the future taxable amounts". That is wrong; the correct statement is: DTA = tax **recoverable** on future **deductible** amounts.
blocks.ms: Slide kata perbezaan sementara boleh ditolak "mewujudkan aset cukai tertunda untuk cukai yang akan dibayar atas amaun boleh dicukai masa depan". Itu salah; pernyataan betul: DTA = cukai **boleh dituntut** atas amaun **boleh ditolak** masa depan.

title.en: The Full Provision (Balance Sheet Liability) Method

en: MFRS 112 requires the **full provision method**: deferred tax on **all temporary differences**, using the **balance sheet liability method**.
Provide **in full**, whether or not future reversals will be offset by others.
The tax effect is recognised as **income tax expense** in profit or loss (statement of comprehensive income) and as an **asset or liability** in the statement of financial position.
Extra: if the item relating to the temporary difference was recognised in **OCI or equity**, the deferred tax is also recognised **in OCI or equity** (e.g. revaluation surplus).
ms: MFRS 112 memerlukan **kaedah peruntukan penuh**: cukai tertunda atas **semua perbezaan sementara**, menggunakan **kaedah liabiliti kunci kira-kira**.
Peruntukkan **sepenuhnya**, sama ada pembalikan masa depan akan diimbangi oleh yang lain atau tidak.
Kesan cukai diiktiraf sebagai **belanja cukai pendapatan** dalam untung atau rugi (penyata pendapatan komprehensif) dan sebagai **aset atau liabiliti** dalam penyata kedudukan kewangan.
Tambahan: jika item berkaitan perbezaan sementara diiktiraf dalam **OCI atau ekuiti**, cukai tertunda juga diiktiraf **dalam OCI atau ekuiti** (cth lebihan penilaian semula).

blocks.en: Deferred tax balance = Temporary difference × Tax rate (the rate expected when it reverses)
blocks.ms: Baki cukai tertunda = Perbezaan sementara × Kadar cukai (kadar dijangka semasa berbalik)

title.en: Deferred Tax Liability & Asset: Worked Examples
title.ms: Liabiliti & Aset Cukai Tertunda: Contoh Kerja

blocks.en: The slides give no figures (Examples 8.1–8.7 are class exercises). The numbers below are invented for practice. Tax rate 24%.
blocks.ms: Slide tiada angka (Contoh 8.1–8.7 ialah latihan kelas). Nombor di bawah direka untuk latihan. Kadar cukai 24%.

blocks.en: A. Taxable temporary difference → DTL
blocks.ms: A. Perbezaan sementara boleh dicukai → DTL

blocks.en: A machine costs RM100,000. Accounting depreciation is RM20,000 a year. Capital allowances (tax depreciation) in year 1 are RM40,000. Profit before tax is RM200,000, with no other differences.
blocks.ms: Mesin kos RM100,000. Susut nilai perakaunan RM20,000 setahun. Elaun modal (susut nilai cukai) tahun 1 ialah RM40,000. Untung sebelum cukai RM200,000, tiada perbezaan lain.

en: RM
ms: RM

en: Carrying amount (100,000 − 20,000)
ms: Amaun dibawa (100,000 − 20,000)

en: Taxable temporary difference
ms: Perbezaan sementara boleh dicukai

en: Deferred tax liability (20,000 × 24%)
ms: Liabiliti cukai tertunda (20,000 × 24%)
Pendapatan boleh cukai: 200,000 + 20,000 − 40,000

en: Current tax (180,000 × 24%)
ms: Cukai semasa (180,000 × 24%)

blocks.en: Check: total tax expense 48,000 = 24% × accounting profit 200,000, because there are no permanent differences.
blocks.ms: Semak: jumlah belanja cukai 48,000 = 24% × untung perakaunan 200,000, kerana tiada perbezaan kekal.

blocks.en: B. Deductible temporary difference → DTA
blocks.ms: B. Perbezaan sementara boleh ditolak → DTA

blocks.en: A RM50,000 warranty provision is expensed this year but is tax-deductible only when paid.
blocks.ms: Peruntukan waranti RM50,000 dibelanjakan tahun ini tetapi boleh ditolak cukai hanya apabila dibayar.

blocks.en: Carrying amount of liability 50,000; tax base 0 (50,000 − 50,000 future deductible); deductible temporary difference 50,000; DTA = 50,000 × 24% = RM12,000.
blocks.ms: Amaun dibawa liabiliti 50,000; asas cukai 0 (50,000 − 50,000 boleh ditolak masa depan); perbezaan sementara boleh ditolak 50,000; DTA = 50,000 × 24% = RM12,000.

blocks.en: C. Permanent difference: no deferred tax
blocks.ms: C. Perbezaan kekal: tiada cukai tertunda

blocks.en: Fines of RM5,000 are never deductible: taxable income is higher by 5,000 (extra current tax 1,200) but there is no deferred tax. The effective tax rate rises above 24%.
blocks.ms: Denda RM5,000 tidak pernah boleh ditolak: pendapatan boleh cukai lebih tinggi 5,000 (cukai semasa tambahan 1,200) tetapi tiada cukai tertunda. Kadar cukai efektif naik melebihi 24%.

en: **DTL:** recognise for **all taxable temporary differences**, with exceptions (below).
**DTA:** recognise **only when it is probable that taxable profit will be available** against which the deductible temporary difference can be used.
Where there is **no such evidence**, the benefit is **unrecognised**. Examples: **unutilised tax losses** and **unabsorbed capital allowances**.
**Disclose** the amount of deductible temporary differences, unused tax losses and credits for which **no DTA is recognised**.
Review the carrying amount of recognised DTAs **at each reporting date** (extra, para 56).
ms: **DTL:** iktiraf untuk **semua perbezaan sementara boleh dicukai**, dengan pengecualian (di bawah).
**DTA:** iktiraf **hanya bila berkemungkinan besar untung boleh cukai akan ada** untuk digunakan terhadap perbezaan sementara boleh ditolak.
Jika **tiada bukti** sedemikian, manfaat **tidak diiktiraf**. Contoh: **kerugian cukai tidak digunakan** dan **elaun modal tidak diserap**.
**Dedah** amaun perbezaan sementara boleh ditolak, kerugian dan kredit cukai tidak digunakan yang **tiada DTA diiktiraf**.
Semak amaun dibawa DTA diiktiraf **pada setiap tarikh pelaporan** (tambahan, para 56).

blocks.en: Exceptions and measurement (extra)
blocks.ms: Pengecualian dan pengukuran (tambahan)

en: **No DTL** on the **initial recognition of goodwill** (para 15(a)).
**No deferred tax** on initial recognition of an asset/liability in a transaction that is **not a business combination** and affects **neither accounting nor taxable profit**.
Measure at the tax rate **enacted or substantively enacted** at the reporting date that is expected to apply when the asset is realised/liability settled.
Deferred tax is **not discounted**.
ms: **Tiada DTL** atas **pengiktirafan awal muhibah (goodwill)** (para 15(a)).
**Tiada cukai tertunda** atas pengiktirafan awal aset/liabiliti dalam transaksi yang **bukan penggabungan perniagaan** dan tidak menjejaskan **untung perakaunan mahupun boleh cukai**.
Ukur pada kadar cukai yang **dikuatkuasakan atau hampir dikuatkuasakan** pada tarikh pelaporan yang dijangka terpakai bila aset direalisasi/liabiliti diselesaikan.
Cukai tertunda **tidak didiskaun**.

en: A **tax loss** arises when tax-deductible expenses **exceed** taxable revenues (negative taxable income). **No tax** is paid that year.

Depending on the jurisdiction, the loss may be used against taxable income of **earlier years (carryback)** or **later years (carry forward)**. The choice depends on expected tax rates and past taxable income.
A **DTA** is recognised for the unused loss **only if** future taxable profit is probable.
ms: **Kerugian cukai** timbul bila perbelanjaan boleh tolak cukai **melebihi** hasil boleh cukai (pendapatan boleh cukai negatif). **Tiada cukai** dibayar tahun itu.

Bergantung bidang kuasa, kerugian boleh digunakan terhadap pendapatan boleh cukai **tahun terdahulu (carryback)** atau **tahun kemudian (carry forward)**. Pilihan bergantung pada kadar cukai dijangka dan pendapatan boleh cukai lalu.
**DTA** diiktiraf untuk kerugian tidak digunakan **hanya jika** untung boleh cukai masa depan berkemungkinan besar.

blocks.en: Extra: in Malaysia, unused business losses are generally carried forward (not carried back), subject to a time limit set by the Income Tax Act. Check the current limit with your lecturer.
blocks.ms: Tambahan: di Malaysia, kerugian perniagaan tidak digunakan biasanya dibawa ke hadapan (bukan ke belakang), tertakluk kepada had masa dalam Akta Cukai Pendapatan. Semak had semasa dengan pensyarah.

blocks.en: Practice (own numbers): tax loss RM100,000; rate 24%; future profits are probable.
blocks.ms: Latihan (nombor sendiri): kerugian cukai RM100,000; kadar 24%; untung masa depan berkemungkinan besar.

blocks.title: Recognise the DTA on the tax loss

blocks.en: If future profits are NOT probable, record nothing and disclose the unrecognised amount.
blocks.ms: Jika untung masa depan TIDAK berkemungkinan besar, tiada rekod dan dedah amaun tidak diiktiraf.

en: **Compound (hybrid) instruments** have both **debt and equity** features (e.g. convertible bonds).
**Financial reporting:** separate the **liability** and **equity** components at initial recognition (MFRS 132).
**Tax:** the split creates a **temporary difference** between the **carrying amount of the liability component** and its **tax base**: this has deferred tax implications.
**Tax base of a liability = Carrying amount − Future deductible amounts + Future taxable amounts.**
ms: **Instrumen majmuk (hibrid)** mempunyai ciri **hutang dan ekuiti** (cth bon boleh tukar).
**Pelaporan kewangan:** asingkan komponen **liabiliti** dan **ekuiti** semasa pengiktirafan awal (MFRS 132).
**Cukai:** pemisahan mewujudkan **perbezaan sementara** antara **amaun dibawa komponen liabiliti** dan **asas cukai**nya: ini ada kesan cukai tertunda.
**Asas cukai liabiliti = Amaun dibawa − Amaun boleh ditolak masa depan + Amaun boleh dicukai masa depan.**

blocks.en: Practice (own numbers, extra): a convertible bond raises RM1,000,000. The liability component is RM900,000 and equity RM100,000. The tax authority treats the whole RM1,000,000 as debt (tax base RM1,000,000). Rate 24%.
blocks.ms: Latihan (nombor sendiri, tambahan): bon boleh tukar menaikkan RM1,000,000. Komponen liabiliti RM900,000 dan ekuiti RM100,000. Pihak berkuasa cukai melayan keseluruhan RM1,000,000 sebagai hutang (asas cukai RM1,000,000). Kadar 24%.

blocks.en: Carrying amount 900,000 < tax base 1,000,000 → taxable temporary difference 100,000 → DTL = 100,000 × 24% = RM24,000, charged to the equity component (equity 100,000 → 76,000), per MFRS 112 para 23.
blocks.ms: Amaun dibawa 900,000 < asas cukai 1,000,000 → perbezaan sementara boleh dicukai 100,000 → DTL = 100,000 × 24% = RM24,000, dicajkan kepada komponen ekuiti (ekuiti 100,000 → 76,000), menurut MFRS 112 para 23.

blocks.en: This compound-instrument calculation goes beyond the slides: confirm the expected depth with your lecturer.
blocks.ms: Pengiraan instrumen majmuk ini melangkaui slide: sahkan kedalaman dijangka dengan pensyarah.

en: **Share-based payments:** payments by issuing equity instruments or cash payments based on share price (**MFRS 2**).
The expense is charged **over the vesting period**.
For tax, the **deduction** is usually allowed **only when the options are exercised** (later).
So a **temporary difference** arises. As the slide states, the **tax base** of the share-based payment is **nil**; a **DTA** arises on the expense already recognised.
ms: **Bayaran berasaskan saham:** bayaran dengan mengeluarkan instrumen ekuiti atau bayaran tunai berasaskan harga saham (**MFRS 2**).
Belanja dicajkan **sepanjang tempoh vesting**.
Untuk cukai, **potongan** biasanya dibenarkan **hanya apabila opsyen dilaksanakan** (kemudian).
Jadi **perbezaan sementara** timbul. Seperti slide, **asas cukai** bayaran berasaskan saham ialah **sifar**; **DTA** timbul atas belanja yang telah diiktiraf.

blocks.en: Extra (MFRS 112 para 68A–68C): the DTA is measured on the estimated future tax deduction (based on the intrinsic value at the reporting date). If that deduction exceeds the cumulative expense recognised, the tax on the excess is recognised in equity.
blocks.ms: Tambahan (MFRS 112 para 68A–68C): DTA diukur atas anggaran potongan cukai masa depan (berdasarkan nilai intrinsik pada tarikh pelaporan). Jika potongan itu melebihi belanja terkumpul diiktiraf, cukai atas lebihan diiktiraf dalam ekuiti.

en: Scenario
Accounting treatment
ms: Senario
Layanan perakaunan

en: Tax rates differ in the years the temporary difference will reverse
Match the tax rate for each year with the future taxable/deductible amount for that year. Deferred tax = total tax effect over those years.
ms: Kadar cukai berbeza pada tahun perbezaan sementara akan berbalik
Padankan kadar cukai setiap tahun dengan amaun boleh dicukai/ditolak masa depan tahun itu. Cukai tertunda = jumlah kesan cukai sepanjang tahun-tahun itu.

en: Changes are made to tax rates and laws

Apply the new rate to current tax and to deferred tax balances; adjust the deferred tax accounts during the year; the effect goes to income in the year of change, except for items previously charged to equity (MFRS 112 para 60).
ms: Perubahan dibuat pada kadar dan undang-undang cukai

Guna kadar baharu pada cukai semasa dan baki cukai tertunda; laras akaun cukai tertunda dalam tahun itu; kesan ke pendapatan dalam tahun perubahan, kecuali item yang sebelum ini dicajkan kepada ekuiti (MFRS 112 para 60).

blocks.en: Practice (own numbers): DTL RM4,800 (temporary difference RM20,000 at 24%). The enacted rate falls to 22%.
blocks.ms: Latihan (nombor sendiri): DTL RM4,800 (perbezaan sementara RM20,000 pada 24%). Kadar dikuatkuasakan jatuh kepada 22%.

blocks.en: New DTL = 20,000 × 22% = 4,400. Reduce the DTL by 400: Dr Deferred tax liability 400; Cr Income tax expense 400.
blocks.ms: DTL baharu = 20,000 × 22% = 4,400. Kurangkan DTL sebanyak 400: Dr Liabiliti cukai tertunda 400; Cr Belanja cukai pendapatan 400.

en: A company usually has **several** temporary differences, taxable and deductible.
**Total future taxable amounts × future tax rate** = balance of the **deferred tax liability**.
**Total future deductible amounts × future tax rate** = balance of the **deferred tax asset**.
ms: Syarikat biasanya ada **beberapa** perbezaan sementara, boleh dicukai dan boleh ditolak.
**Jumlah amaun boleh dicukai masa depan × kadar cukai masa depan** = baki **liabiliti cukai tertunda**.
**Jumlah amaun boleh ditolak masa depan × kadar cukai masa depan** = baki **aset cukai tertunda**.

blocks.en: Practice (own numbers, rate 24%): taxable temporary differences — accelerated capital allowances RM20,000 and revaluation of land RM30,000. Deductible temporary differences — warranty provision RM50,000 and doubtful debts allowance RM10,000.
blocks.ms: Latihan (nombor sendiri, kadar 24%): perbezaan sementara boleh dicukai — elaun modal dipercepat RM20,000 dan penilaian semula tanah RM30,000. Perbezaan sementara boleh ditolak — peruntukan waranti RM50,000 dan elaun hutang ragu RM10,000.
DTL = (20,000 + 30,000) × 24% = RM12,000. DTA = (50,000 + 10,000) × 24% = RM14,400. DTA bersih = RM2,400 jika pelarasan dibenarkan.

blocks.en: Extra (para 74): offset DTA and DTL only if the entity has a legally enforceable right to offset current tax and both relate to taxes levied by the same authority.
blocks.ms: Tambahan (para 74): imbangkan (offset) DTA dan DTL hanya jika entiti ada hak sah untuk mengimbangi cukai semasa dan kedua-duanya berkaitan cukai yang dikenakan oleh pihak berkuasa sama.

en: **Current** tax expense/income.
**Deferred** tax expense/income relating to the **origination and reversal** of temporary differences.
Income tax taken to **profit or loss, OCI and equity**.
**Tax effect of each type** of temporary difference, unused tax losses and unused tax credits.
Amount of **deductible temporary differences, unused tax losses and unused tax credits for which no deferred tax is recognised**.
ms: Belanja/pendapatan cukai **semasa**.
Belanja/pendapatan cukai **tertunda** berkaitan **permulaan dan pembalikan** perbezaan sementara.
Cukai pendapatan dibawa ke **untung atau rugi, OCI dan ekuiti**.
**Kesan cukai setiap jenis** perbezaan sementara, kerugian cukai tidak digunakan dan kredit cukai tidak digunakan.
Amaun **perbezaan sementara boleh ditolak, kerugian cukai dan kredit cukai tidak digunakan yang tiada cukai tertunda diiktiraf**.

title.en: Issues in Accounting for Deferred Tax

blocks.en: Business combinations
blocks.ms: Penggabungan perniagaan

en: Identifiable assets and liabilities are measured at **fair value**; the **tax base** often stays at the old cost, so **temporary differences** arise at acquisition.
**No DTL** on the **initial recognition of goodwill** (MFRS 112 para 15(a)).
New information about facts at the acquisition date can change the **probability of realising a pre-acquisition DTA**.
ms: Aset dan liabiliti boleh dikenal pasti diukur pada **nilai saksama**; **asas cukai** sering kekal pada kos lama, jadi **perbezaan sementara** timbul semasa perolehan.
**Tiada DTL** atas **pengiktirafan awal muhibah** (MFRS 112 para 15(a)).
Maklumat baharu tentang fakta pada tarikh perolehan boleh mengubah **kebarangkalian merealisasi DTA pra-perolehan**.

blocks.en: Consolidated financial statements
blocks.ms: Penyata kewangan disatukan

en: Recognise deferred tax on **unrealised intra-group profits**: on the difference between the inventory's **carrying amount** (after eliminating the profit) and its **tax base** (cost to the buying company).
**Complexity:** group companies may pay tax at **different rates**; the rate and tax base must be consistent (use the buyer's rate).
ms: Iktiraf cukai tertunda atas **untung dalam kumpulan belum direalisasi**: atas beza antara **amaun dibawa** inventori (selepas menghapus untung) dan **asas cukai**nya (kos kepada syarikat pembeli).
**Kerumitan:** syarikat kumpulan mungkin membayar cukai pada **kadar berbeza**; kadar dan asas cukai mesti konsisten (guna kadar pembeli).

blocks.en: Practice (own numbers): unrealised intra-group profit in closing inventory is RM20,000; the buyer's tax rate is 24%.
blocks.ms: Latihan (nombor sendiri): untung dalam kumpulan belum direalisasi dalam inventori akhir ialah RM20,000; kadar cukai pembeli 24%.

blocks.en: Carrying amount (group) is RM20,000 lower than the tax base (buyer's cost) → deductible temporary difference 20,000 → DTA = 20,000 × 24% = RM4,800 (Dr Deferred tax asset; Cr Income tax expense, consolidation adjustment).
blocks.ms: Amaun dibawa (kumpulan) RM20,000 lebih rendah daripada asas cukai (kos pembeli) → perbezaan sementara boleh ditolak 20,000 → DTA = 20,000 × 24% = RM4,800 (Dr Aset cukai tertunda; Cr Belanja cukai pendapatan, pelarasan penyatuan).

q.en: Why does deferred tax arise?
q.ms: Kenapa cukai tertunda timbul?

a.en: Accounting profit (MFRS) and taxable income (tax law) are calculated differently.
a.ms: Untung perakaunan (MFRS) dan pendapatan boleh cukai (undang-undang cukai) dikira secara berbeza.

q.en: Total tax expense formula
q.ms: Formula jumlah belanja cukai

a.en: Current tax + deferred tax.
a.ms: Cukai semasa + cukai tertunda.

q.en: Permanent difference: definition and effect
q.ms: Perbezaan kekal: takrif dan kesan

a.en: Item never taxable or never deductible; it never reverses; no deferred tax.
a.ms: Item tidak pernah dicukai atau tidak pernah boleh ditolak; tidak berbalik; tiada cukai tertunda.

q.en: Examples of non-deductible items
q.ms: Contoh item tidak boleh ditolak

a.en: Fines and penalties; donations to unapproved charities; meals and entertainment.
a.ms: Denda dan penalti; derma kepada badan kebajikan tidak diluluskan; makanan dan hiburan.

q.en: Examples of non-taxable items
q.ms: Contoh item tidak dicukai

a.en: Tax-exempt interest; life insurance proceeds on an insured executive's death; tax-exempt dividends.
a.ms: Faedah dikecualikan cukai; hasil insurans hayat atas kematian eksekutif; dividen dikecualikan cukai.

q.en: Temporary difference: definition
q.ms: Perbezaan sementara: takrif

a.en: Item treated differently for tax and accounting that reverses over time; has deferred tax consequences.
a.ms: Item dilayan berbeza untuk cukai dan perakaunan yang berbalik dari masa ke masa; ada kesan cukai tertunda.

q.en: Tax base (asset) and temporary difference formula
q.ms: Asas cukai (aset) dan formula perbezaan sementara

a.en: Temporary difference = carrying amount − tax base.
a.ms: Perbezaan sementara = amaun dibawa − asas cukai.

q.en: Taxable temporary difference: asset/liability condition
q.ms: Perbezaan sementara boleh dicukai: syarat aset/liabiliti

a.en: Asset: CA > tax base. Liability: CA < tax base. Result: DTL.
a.ms: Aset: CA > asas cukai. Liabiliti: CA < asas cukai. Hasil: DTL.

q.en: Deductible temporary difference: asset/liability condition
q.ms: Perbezaan sementara boleh ditolak: syarat aset/liabiliti

a.en: Asset: CA < tax base. Liability: CA > tax base. Result: DTA.
a.ms: Aset: CA < asas cukai. Liabiliti: CA > asas cukai. Hasil: DTA.

q.en: DTL vs DTA in one line
q.ms: DTL vs DTA dalam satu baris

a.en: DTL = tax payable on future taxable amounts; DTA = tax recoverable on future deductible amounts.
a.ms: DTL = cukai kena bayar atas amaun boleh dicukai masa depan; DTA = cukai boleh dituntut atas amaun boleh ditolak masa depan.

q.en: Which method does MFRS 112 require?
q.ms: Kaedah mana MFRS 112 minta?

a.en: Full provision method, balance sheet liability method, on all temporary differences.
a.ms: Kaedah peruntukan penuh, kaedah liabiliti kunci kira-kira, atas semua perbezaan sementara.

q.en: Formula for deferred tax balance
q.ms: Formula baki cukai tertunda

a.en: Temporary difference × tax rate expected on reversal.
a.ms: Perbezaan sementara × kadar cukai dijangka semasa berbalik.

q.en: Accelerated capital allowance → ?
q.ms: Elaun modal dipercepat → ?

a.en: Tax base falls below carrying amount → taxable temporary difference → DTL.
a.ms: Asas cukai jatuh di bawah amaun dibawa → perbezaan sementara boleh dicukai → DTL.

q.en: Warranty provision not yet deductible → ?
q.ms: Peruntukan waranti belum boleh ditolak → ?

a.en: Liability CA > tax base (0) → deductible temporary difference → DTA.
a.ms: Liabiliti CA > asas cukai (0) → perbezaan sementara boleh ditolak → DTA.

q.en: Do fines create deferred tax?
q.ms: Adakah denda mewujudkan cukai tertunda?

a.en: No: a permanent difference; it only changes the effective tax rate.
a.ms: Tidak: perbezaan kekal; ia hanya mengubah kadar cukai efektif.

q.en: When is a DTA recognised?
q.ms: Bila DTA diiktiraf?

a.en: Only when it is probable that taxable profit will be available to use the deductible difference.
a.ms: Hanya bila berkemungkinan besar untung boleh cukai ada untuk guna perbezaan boleh ditolak.

q.en: Unrecognised DTA: examples and disclosure
q.ms: DTA tidak diiktiraf: contoh dan pendedahan

a.en: Unutilised tax losses; unabsorbed capital allowances. Disclose the amounts.
a.ms: Kerugian cukai tidak digunakan; elaun modal tidak diserap. Dedah amaunnya.

q.en: Goodwill and deferred tax
q.ms: Muhibah dan cukai tertunda

a.en: No DTL on initial recognition of goodwill (para 15(a)).
a.ms: Tiada DTL atas pengiktirafan awal muhibah (para 15(a)).

q.en: Which tax rate is used?
q.ms: Kadar cukai mana digunakan?

a.en: Enacted or substantively enacted rate expected when the asset is realised or liability settled; no discounting.
a.ms: Kadar dikuatkuasakan atau hampir dikuatkuasakan dijangka bila aset direalisasi atau liabiliti diselesaikan; tiada diskaun.

q.en: Tax loss and DTA
q.ms: Kerugian cukai dan DTA

a.en: DTA = unused loss × tax rate, only if future taxable profit is probable.
a.ms: DTA = kerugian tidak digunakan × kadar cukai, hanya jika untung boleh cukai masa depan berkemungkinan besar.

q.en: Carryback vs carry forward
q.ms: Carryback vs carry forward

a.en: Use the loss against earlier years (carryback) or later years (carry forward). In Malaysia generally carry forward.
a.ms: Guna kerugian terhadap tahun terdahulu (carryback) atau tahun kemudian (carry forward). Di Malaysia biasanya carry forward.

q.en: Compound instrument: tax base of the liability
q.ms: Instrumen majmuk: asas cukai liabiliti

a.en: Carrying amount − future deductible amounts + future taxable amounts.
a.ms: Amaun dibawa − amaun boleh ditolak masa depan + amaun boleh dicukai masa depan.

q.en: Why do compound instruments create temporary differences?
q.ms: Kenapa instrumen majmuk mewujudkan perbezaan sementara?

a.en: Accounting splits liability and equity; tax may treat the whole as debt, so carrying amount differs from tax base.
a.ms: Perakaunan memisah liabiliti dan ekuiti; cukai mungkin layan keseluruhan sebagai hutang, jadi amaun dibawa berbeza daripada asas cukai.

q.en: Share-based payment: why a temporary difference?
q.ms: Bayaran berasaskan saham: kenapa perbezaan sementara?

a.en: Expense over vesting period, but tax deduction only on exercise; tax base nil → DTA.
a.ms: Belanja sepanjang tempoh vesting, tetapi potongan cukai hanya semasa laksana; asas cukai sifar → DTA.

q.en: Rates differ across reversal years
q.ms: Kadar berbeza antara tahun pembalikan

a.en: Match each year's rate with that year's taxable/deductible amount.
a.ms: Padankan kadar setiap tahun dengan amaun boleh dicukai/ditolak tahun itu.

q.en: Tax rate change: where does the adjustment go?
q.ms: Perubahan kadar cukai: pelarasan ke mana?

a.en: Income (P/L) in the year of change, except items previously charged to equity.
a.ms: Pendapatan (P/L) dalam tahun perubahan, kecuali item yang sebelum ini dicajkan ke ekuiti.

q.en: Multiple temporary differences
q.ms: Banyak perbezaan sementara

a.en: Total taxable amounts × rate = DTL; total deductible amounts × rate = DTA.
a.ms: Jumlah amaun boleh dicukai × kadar = DTL; jumlah amaun boleh ditolak × kadar = DTA.

q.en: Key deferred tax disclosures
q.ms: Pendedahan utama cukai tertunda

a.en: Current and deferred tax expense; tax in OCI/equity; tax effect per type of difference; unrecognised amounts.
a.ms: Belanja cukai semasa dan tertunda; cukai dalam OCI/ekuiti; kesan cukai setiap jenis perbezaan; amaun tidak diiktiraf.

q.en: Business combination and deferred tax
q.ms: Penggabungan perniagaan dan cukai tertunda

a.en: Fair-value adjustments create temporary differences; no DTL on initial goodwill.
a.ms: Pelarasan nilai saksama mewujudkan perbezaan sementara; tiada DTL atas muhibah awal.

a.en: Inventory CA (after elimination) < tax base → deductible difference → DTA at the buyer's tax rate.

q.en: Distinguish between permanent and temporary differences, with examples, and explain why only temporary differences give rise to deferred tax.
q.ms: Bezakan perbezaan kekal dan sementara, dengan contoh, dan terangkan kenapa hanya perbezaan sementara menimbulkan cukai tertunda.

en: Permanent: never taxable/deductible, never reverses (1)
Examples: fines, unapproved donations, meals and entertainment, tax-exempt income (2)
Temporary: treated differently but reverses over time (1)
Temporary differences create future taxable/deductible amounts → DTL/DTA (1)
Permanent differences only change the effective tax rate (1)
ms: Kekal: tidak pernah dicukai/ditolak, tidak berbalik (1)
Contoh: denda, derma tidak diluluskan, makanan dan hiburan, pendapatan dikecualikan cukai (2)
Sementara: dilayan berbeza tetapi berbalik dari masa ke masa (1)
Perbezaan sementara mewujudkan amaun boleh dicukai/ditolak masa depan → DTL/DTA (1)
Perbezaan kekal hanya mengubah kadar cukai efektif (1)

(a) Kira amaun dibawa, asas cukai dan cukai tertunda pada akhir tahun 1. (b) Kira cukai semasa dan jumlah belanja cukai. (c) Beri jurnal.

en: Taxable temporary difference 30,000; DTL = 30,000 × 24% = 7,200 (2)
Dr Income tax expense 72,000; Cr Tax payable 64,800; Cr DTL 7,200 (2)
ms: Perbezaan sementara boleh dicukai 30,000; DTL = 30,000 × 24% = 7,200 (2)
Dr Belanja cukai 72,000; Cr Cukai kena bayar 64,800; Cr DTL 7,200 (2)
